name: mushaf.js
description: Interactive Madani Mushaf renderer with word/ayah/surah-level interaction

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --clean && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('styles/mushaf.css','dist/mushaf.min.css')" && npm run build:browser
scripts.build:browser: tsup src/index.ts --format iife --global-name Mushaf --minify --out-dir dist/browser && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.renameSync('dist/browser/index.global.js','dist/mushaf.min.js');fs.rmSync('dist/browser',{recursive:true})"

author: YouBar Solutions
